reason: 'Apex rounded' of the leaf blade; PATO obtuse lists 'roundish' as a synonym and there is no separate rounded-apex term. This is acceptable for apices, though not for crowns or whole outlines.

fix: Pattern 'faces ... (the varnish, in age, becoming whitish)': the parenthesis describes the coating on the leaf surface, not the blade itself. Do not lift a quality inside a parenthesis that names its own subject onto the outer part.
reason: What turns whitish and opaque is the varnish (resin coating), and only with age. The leaf blade is not white. The 'in age' stage is also missing.
The pinna lobes are oblong; leaf lamina lobe is an acceptable part for fern pinna lobes.
The cyathium has 4 glands. 'Gland' → portion of secretory tissue (PO_0005656) follows the reviewed bearer rule C265.
Seeds numerous = seeds present, amount many.
Stamens shorter than sepals; the comparison target is sepal.

fix: 'Pyrene(s)' should map to FLOPO_0986026 pyrene (new class; review rule C438 'stone' → pyrene), not to seed (PO lists it only as a narrow synonym).
reason: The ribs are absent on the pyrenes (stones), which are seed plus endocarp, not on the seed.

fix: In Fabaceae flower descriptions, 'keel' should map to PO_0025327 keel, not petal.
reason: The 12–14(–15) mm length belongs to the keel of the papilionaceous flower. Petal is too general, and the wings and standard are petals of other sizes.
The sepal apex is shortly acuminate.
The stem is glabrous at the base.
Graines nombreuses = seeds present, many.

fix: For 'lateral wings ... not thickened' after 'Fruit', the part is the fruit wing (a part of the fruit). Bare 'wing' is rejected as a generic part, so the part needs to be the wing of the fruit, not the whole fruit.
reason: The wings are not thickened. The fruit as a whole is not described as unthickened.
Without latex = latex absent.

fix: 'Reticulate veins' names the vein network (leaf vascular system / venation), and 'evident' adds conspicuous (PATO_0000463). Put the pattern on the venation, not on the leaf.
reason: The reticulate pattern belongs to the venation. The statement says that network is visible on both surfaces.

fix: Pattern 'A to B or C': read it as (A to B) or C. The relation must keep 'green' as the start of the range, not only 'B or C'.
reason: Only 'reddish or brown' was captured. Green, the first and usual colour of the petiole, is lost.

fix: 'Abaxially puberulent along veins': 'along veins' limits the hairs to the veins. Keep it as a place (veins of the abaxial surface) rather than the whole surface.
reason: Annotating the whole abaxial surface as puberulent overstates the source; the hairs are only along the veins.
The anthers range from straight to slightly bent; the values are straight and bent, with 'slightly' as the degree.
The calyx limb is divided into 4 lobes, so there are 4 calyx lobes.

fix: Same 'A to B or C' pattern: lanceolate to spathulate, or rhombic. The first value (lanceolate) must be kept.
reason: Only spathulate or rhomboid was captured; lanceolate is lost.
The infructescence is silver-white when mature; the 'mature' stage is kept.

fix: 'Corolla tube' should map to FLOPO_0985018 corolla tube, not corolla. The lobes are white, so 'corolla maroon' is false.
reason: Only the corolla tube is maroon (and yellow); the corolla lobes are white to rose.

fix: In a parenthetical '(sometimes scarcely at all)', 'sometimes' belongs to 'scarcely at all', not to the main value. The main statement is always shortly mucronate.
reason: The tepals are mucronate in general and only sometimes barely so. The 'sometimes' frequency on 'mucronate' is wrong.
The petals are deep purple, lavender or white. Lavender → violet is an acceptable colour grouping.
Few-flowered inflorescence = flowers present, few, in the inflorescence.
An annual plant.
The sepal apex is obtuse.

fix: Pattern 'with or without X': X is present or absent (variable). 'With' must not be read as glabrous, and the hairs are on the costa of the dorsal surface, not the whole lamina.
reason: The parse inverted the meaning ('with' → glabrous) and spread costal hairs over the whole lamina.
7–10 secondary veins on each side of the midvein.
The lateral sepals are not saccate at the base. A negated 'sepal saccate' is still true, though the base and lateral-pair position are not kept.

fix: 'Tube corollin' (French) should map to corolla tube FLOPO_0985018. 'S'élargissant dès la base' (gradually widening from the base) is closer to a funnel or obconic shape than to dilated.
reason: The widening is of the corolla tube. Dilated (made wider, as in 'expanded') is a loose fit for a tube that widens gradually.
